# Reporting security vulnerabilities

Please do **not** report security vulnerabilities as a public issue.

Use GitHub instead: *Security → Report a vulnerability* (“Private vulnerability reporting”) in the repository
[cberthun/domainscope](https://github.com/cberthun/domainscope/security/advisories/new).
If that is not possible, write to **projects@cberthun.de** (please no details of the vulnerability in the subject line).

Please include: affected version, description, steps to reproduce and the possible impact. I answer as soon as possible and publish a fix
as a new release.

Only the **latest version** is supported. The threat model is in [docs/SECURITY.md](../docs/SECURITY.md).
